scope: bounded read-only aggregate cardinality/shape metadata; no identifiers, row payloads, business function or state change
query:
BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='8s';
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS captured_at,
count(*) AS total_alerts,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE) AS unresolved,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE AND source IN ('postHandTasks.hand_history_failed','ServerTableEngine.authoritative_hand_semantic_refusal')) AS class4_unresolved,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE AND source='fn_payout_guarantee_check') AS class1_source_unresolved,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE AND source='fn_tournament_payout_reconcile') AS class2_source_unresolved,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE AND source='ServerTableEngine.post_commit_obligations_pending') AS class3_source_unresolved,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE AND source IN ('postHandTasks.hand_history_failed','ServerTableEngine.authoritative_hand_semantic_refusal') AND jsonb_typeof(context->'hand_request_identity_v1')='object') AS class4_identity_object_count,
max(octet_length(coalesce(context,'null'::jsonb)::text)) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE) AS unresolved_max_context_bytes,
percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY octet_length(coalesce(context,'null'::jsonb)::text)) FILTER (WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE) AS unresolved_p95_context_bytes,
pg_total_relation_size('public.financial_alerts') AS alert_total_relation_bytes,
(SELECT reltuples::bigint FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.hand_atomic_commits'::regclass) AS canonical_estimated_rows,
pg_total_relation_size('public.hand_atomic_commits') AS canonical_total_relation_bytes
FROM public.financial_alerts;
ROLLBACK;
